deadline.value: Apply by January 10, 2027 (same date for US and non-US applicants).

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are listed as a test requirement, and the department expects near-perfect quantitative scores from PhD applicants.

also.quote: particularly for PhD applicants, near-perfect quantitative scores are expected

supervisor.value: You do not need to find a faculty member before applying; you may name faculty of interest in the statement of purpose.
supervisor.quote: No, but in your statement of purpose you can always mention names of faculty members whose research is of interest to you.

funding.value: The FAQ says all admitted PhD students are guaranteed full funding for five years; the department's financing page describes limited four-year packages, so confirm the terms.
funding.quote: All admitted Ph. D students are guaranteed full funding (assistantship in the form of TA/Ga, tuition remission, health insurance) for five years subject to remaining in good academic standing.

also.quote: These packages provide funding for four years, with the first year as a fellowship and the following years as assistantships.

entry_route.value: Applications from students with a four-year bachelor's degree are accepted, but need to be very strong.
entry_route.quote: We accept Ph.D. applications from students who have a four-year bachelor's degree, but the applications need to be really strong to be shortlisted or selected.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: TOEFL minimums are set by the graduate school (department FAQ).
